text:
Ellen (PM): quick alignment thread on the design-partner pilot — main open items: slot types, how we prioritize partner asks vs backlog, feedback cadence expectations, incentives, and slot replacement rules. need a go/no-go by EOD.

Ravi (Eng): propose two lanes: "operational" (bug triage + config help) included, and "product requests" which become RFCs. For product requests we’ll commit to triage within 7 days but not delivery unless scoped.

Camille (CS): agree. recruitment filter: active integration in last 60 days + named POC. scoring: usage(40), POC availability(30), strategic-fit(30).

Ilya (Design): feedback format: required 4-question form after each milestone + optional 20m recorded session for deep partners. keep forms focused on actionability.

Noor (Legal): minimal pilot addendum ok — telemetry consent + feedback IP clause + brief rollback clause. avoid custom legal for SMBs.

Ellen (PM): draft slot plan: 9 total (3 Deep / 4 Standard / 2 Flex). Deep = 3h/week expected, Standard = async ~1 form/2w, Flex = fill-as-needed. Incentives: Deep = $1k credit + priority bug queue; Standard = $300 credit. on-time bonus: $250 if partner completes required feedback in first month.

Ravi (Eng): operational constraints: SE time cap = 12h/week total (max 4h/Deep partner). KV warm-cache allowed for Deep only, 10 day max, one window per partner. need auto-teardown after window.

Camille (CS): missed-commit rule: if partner misses two scheduled checkpoints or fails to return 2 required forms in a 30-day period -> probation. probation = 72h to reschedule/respond, else slot released. pilot-bot should manage probation notifications.

pilot-bot: configured probation flow: send probation notice -> 72h accept/reschedule -> if no action mark slot "released" and invite next waitlist candidate with 48h to accept.

Ilya (Design): UX ask: add "time commitment" badge in invite (Deep=~3h/wk, Standard=~1h/2w). include checkbox for telemetry opt-in and security approver presence.

Noor (Legal): privacy note: mark regulated industries (health/finance) as high-compliance; require security contact and run security intake — may add 7-14 days to onboarding. flag these in the recruitment sheet.

Ellen (PM): acceptance gates for partner activation: smoke test green, telemetry consent (if Deep), kickoff recorded, baseline survey returned. program-level success: avg feedback score >=6/10 and >=3 actionable items surfaced in first 30 days.

Ravi (Eng): rollback playbook: if partner causes regression affecting other customers, we will execute immediate rollback/canary and pause partner slot until RCA. tag incidents with pilot_slot_id.

Camille (CS): replacement waitlist behavior: top 3 waitlist candidates get notified simultaneously; first to accept gets slot. show waitlist position in email so partners know where they stand.

Ilya (Design): metrics to capture per partner: sentiment (-2..+2), response latency, feedback completion rate, and "actionability" boolean for each item. surface on dashboard.

Noor (Legal): add simple checkbox in invite: "I confirm I have rights to share telemetry and that our org approves this pilot". link to addendum.

Ellen (PM): special incentive for high-quality feedback: if a partner's feedback leads to an implemented fix within 2 sprints, award additional $500 credit. want to encourage actionable notes.

Ravi (Eng): scheduling constraint: avoid >2 Deep partners that require overlapping SE office hours (same 4-hour block) to prevent overload. add timezone cap in sheet.

Camille (CS): recruitment email draft: "Short: invite to an early pilot of Redwood Dedicated. Deep asks ~3h/week (calls + forms). Incentive: $1k credit + priority bug queue. Can you commit? Provide POC & timezone & security approver."

Ellen (PM): OK I'll consolidate into a one-pager and the invite spreadsheet. quick thumbs?

Ravi (Eng): :thumbsup:

Camille (CS): :thumbsup:

Ilya (Design): :thumbsup:

Noor (Legal): :thumbsup:

Ellen (PM): thanks. planning to send invites 09:30 PT tomorrow and link pilot-bot to the spreadsheet. ping me if anything major pops up.
